title: When using an ambient user in a first transfer doing Negotiate authentication and asked to follow redirects, curl could pass on its credential… (CVE-2026-86413)
description: CVE-2026-86413 is a vulnerability in curl where using an ambient user for Negotiate authentication combined with following redirects could cause curl to send credential details to an unrelated second origin during a redirect.
aiSummary: This vulnerability occurs when curl is configured to use an ambient user for Negotiate authentication in an initial transfer and is also set to follow HTTP redirects. Under these conditions, curl may inadvertently pass its authentication credentials to a redirected URL that belongs to a different origin, potentially exposing sensitive credential information to an unintended party.
aiImpact: The impact is the unintended disclosure of authentication credentials to an unrelated second origin during HTTP redirects. This could lead to credential leakage and unauthorized access if the redirected destination is malicious or compromised. No information about active exploitation or CVSS score is provided.
